title: 输出二维数组元素
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multi-Dimensional Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given a two-dimensional array with 3 rows and 3 columns -- 9 elements.
Here is the array:[code format="cpp" ]string arr[3][3] = {
    {"Python", "JS", "C++"},
    {"PHP", "SQL", "Java"},
    {"C#", "Swift", "Kotlin"},
};[/code]
[b]Task
[/b]Complete the code to output [b]C++[/b] .

[b]Hint[/b]
Don't forget that the [b]index[/b] of the first element of the array is [b]0[/b].

[note]In order to call the element with indexes k, j you should write arr[k][j].[/note]
hint_md:
- 不要忘记，数组中第一个元素的**索引**是**0**。
- 为了调用索引为k，j的元素，你应该写`arr[k][j]`。
